behavior: Five more visual directions on /kit/directions, each with its own palette, type and image
acceptance: Given KIT_ENABLED=1, when /kit/directions loads, then eight directions are shown (the existing three plus five new), each with a headline, a primary button, a product panel and its own image
notes: 2026-10-08 review pass by subagent: Pass. Live /kit/directions (port 3000) renders 8 sections: dawn-path, dusk-ledger, halftone-horizon, coastal-ledger, paper-atlas, aurora-night, terracotta-mesa, glass-garden; each new one has headline, Join waitlist button, product-panel (InvoicePanel) and its own image via one config-driven ImageComp (image-comp.tsx) fed by constants/image-directions.ts. Screenshots f021-directions-desktop.png (1440x9101) and -mobile.png (390x7898) cropped per comp: headline, body, button and invoice panel readable on all five (scrims do their job; Aurora uses light ink on dark); each has its own face (Young Serif, Instrument Serif, Unbounded, Bodoni Moda, Sora), palette and image; no overflow at 390 (Paper Atlas headline fits one line, tight). Button contrast accent/onInk OK for all five. Fonts: direction-fonts imported only by app/kit/directions/page.tsx; landing index.html has 0 refs to new font vars, its stylesheet (3n7okyc0sf2m_.css) differs from the chunk holding the new faces. No 'generat' text in rendered page; only docs/images.md rows mention prompts. Images: 5 WebP (VP8), 27-288 KB. Checks: playwright 18 passed; check-images 10 images all recorded; pnpm lint clean (153 files); pnpm typecheck 3/3 ok. Minor, not blocking: D and H share the 'left' layout and E and G share 'center'; 'split' (F) looks close to 'left' at 1440.
